title: The verifier's ballot admission under definition version 6 (ballot version 4): definitions, boards and pinned panels, with the rows 1.3, 2.3, 3.2, 5.1 to 5.5, 5.7, 6.2 and 7.4 and the report's ballots
generator: packages/crypto/scripts/verifier-ballots-v4-vectors.py, from verifier-ceremony-vectors.py, ballot-v4-records-vectors.py and definition-v6-vectors.py (independent Python implementations); membership proofs by packages/crypto/scripts/ballot-proofs.mjs, run outside the workspace with Semaphore 4.14.3's depth-32 circuit artifacts and snarkjs 0.7.5, whose groth16.verify gives every pairing verdict on the signals derived here from each record

cases.description: Definition version 6 without an author panel (pick one of three, pick up to two of four, pick exactly one of two); seat 4 sends nothing, so seats 1 to 3 are registered. The board holds the transcript, an admitted ballot in each cell (both regions of the remainder), a ballot of each admission failure (another election's, cells 3 and 255, a range proof of the wrong shape, an author half the poll has no panel for, a share hash at seat 4, another cell's proof, a changed L1 reference, a vote of 2, question 1 over its maximum, question 2 under its minimum), two records that don't decode, a re-vote and a byte-identical repeat of the first ballot.

Definition version 6 with only admitted ballots after the transcript: one in each cell and a re-vote. 5.1 to 5.5 and 5.7 pass, and so do 6.2 and 7.4, with no spoiled-ballot or tally opening on the board.

Copies of the cell 0 ballot: one with the tier 2 ballot's proof (rejected, so it makes no copy a repeat, R4), the original, a copy with its proof negated, the tier 2 ballot, a byte-identical copy and the re-vote (another M). 5.7 rejects the two copies after the original.
The transcript and no ballot: 5.1 to 5.5 and 5.7 pass, with nothing admitted.
Every seat registered: a share hash at seat 4 is admitted.
Definition version 6 pinning spoiled-ballot opening version 2, which can't open version-4 cores: 2.3 fails profile-combination, admission still judges every ballot, and 6.2 is not reached.
A live version-6 poll: 2.3 fails profile-combination whatever it pins, and admission still judges every ballot.
Definition version 6 pinning contract-event version 8, which frames no version-4 ballot: 2.3 fails profile-combination, and admission still judges every ballot.

A poll with an author panel of 2 of 3 whose transcript isn't on the board: 2.3 fails profile-combination, 3.2 is unverifiable (not-reached: the author panel's run, which 3.2 holds for too, isn't reached) and registers no key set, so 5.1 to 5.5 and 5.7 are not reached.
Seats 3 and 4 answer wrongly: no key set is registered, so no ballot is checked.
Ballot version 4's proofs are checked under the same pinned key as versions 1 to 3's: a definition naming another fails 1.3, and no ballot is checked under it.
The definition gives tier 2's cell a root of 0, which anyone can prove membership of (T-04): no ballot is checked under it.

Definition version 6 pinning ballot version 1, which names a tier and carries one range, beside opening version 1: 2.3 fails profile-combination, and no ballot or opening can be judged against the cells and questions.

Definition version 6 pinning ballot version 3, which carries no author half: 2.3 fails profile-combination, and, as for any ballot version but the definition's own and version 1, 5.1 to 5.5, 5.7 and 6.2 are unsupported.

Definition version 6 pinning ballot version 5, a rolling electorate's: 2.3 fails profile-combination, and, as for any ballot version but the definition's own and version 1, 5.1 to 5.5, 5.7 and 6.2 are unsupported.
Definition version 6 pinning ballot version 255, which a later release may read: 2.3, 5.1 to 5.5, 5.7 and 6.2 are unsupported.
